name: Shoko Relay
overview: A custom metadata provider and automation toolset for integrating Plex and AnimeThemes with Shoko Server.

releases.release_notes:
**Changes:**
- Fall back to TMDB content ratings when AssumedContentRatings is disabled or when no assumed rating tags match
- Add TmdbSeries and IsAdult to SeriesContext to eliminate redundant database queries and parental rating checks
- Update MapSeries and MapEpisode to accept SeriesContext directly, aligning with MapSeason
- Exclude 1-hour frequency from generating 24 daily triggers in ActionScheduleHelper.cs and fall back to a single hourly interval trigger
- Patch path traversal in Log/WebM endpoints and SourceLinkService
- Bump Shoko.Abstractions to v6.0.0-alpha.125
- Minor README/Controller.md tweaks

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.21.3...v0.21.4

This release is a general optimisation pass with some improvements across the board for VFS builds and metadata lookups. The most significant improvement affects series that have alternate episode orderings assigned to them (which were incorrectly querying Shoko's database multiple times per episode causing massive performance degradation).

**Changes:**
- Massively improved metadata provider response times and eliminated potential thread pool starvation during large library scans
- Added an in-memory series context cache with automatic invalidation during VFS updates and scheduled metadata fixups
- Drastically sped up alternate TMDB episode group resolution by replacing repeated database queries with pre-indexed lookups
- Optimized cast and crew deduplication by replacing linear name scans and runtime string splitting with indexed lookups
- Accelerated VFS generation by linking series-level metadata once per folder and skipping redundant disk checks on clean builds
- Slightly sped up VFS Browser and AnimeThemes Player loading by caching tree data, batching disk checks, and implementing lazy UI rendering
- Bumped Shoko.Abstractions to v6.0.0-alpha.120

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.21.2...v0.21.3

**Changes:**
- Updated PlexMetadataItem to include Media and Part properties to support physical file path extraction
- Added GetFallbackLibraryTargetAsync to PlexClient to allow querying Plex for libraries not using the Shoko Relay provider
- Updated SyncToShoko to intercept specific library filters and engage a legacy fallback mode if the library is not a recognized Relay target
- Implemented filename-based matching fallback within SyncToShoko to map Plex's physical paths against Shoko's VideoFiles
- Added missing diagnostic logging for the admin user fetch in SyncHelper.cs to ensure transparency for all processed users
- Updated README/Controller.md to document the fallback migration feature
- Bumped Shoko.Abstractions to v6.0.0-alpha.115

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.21.1...v0.21.2

Further fixes related to Plex Server changes from [CVE-2026-96655](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9x88-w2p7-56vh)

**Changes:**
- Modified the image upload method in PlexCollections.cs to utilise direct file stream uploads preventing DNS/networking errors on restricted networks
- Updated CollectionService.cs to supply raw file paths to the Plex API and remove the legacy NormalizeCacheUrl helper
- Added hidden RequireSubtitleLanguageCodes advanced setting

**Contributions:**
* @Foowy in https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/pull/21

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.21.0...v0.21.1

A small but breaking change has been made in the abstractions which should help to enhance cast deduplication performance.

**Changes:**
- Enhance FindMatchingTmdbEntry to compare whitespace-stripped AniDB OriginalName values against whitespace-stripped TMDB OriginalName and TMDB AlternativeNames as high-priority fast paths
- Remove the AniDB `AlternativeNames` check, as Shoko doesn't populate alternate names for AniDB creators
- Implement a 5th pass in `FindMatchingTmdbEntry` to compare AniDB's romanised Name (and its flipped variant) against TMDB AlternativeNames (and their flipped variants) to ensure accurate fallback matching
- Read a creator's and a character's name from `Title`, their original name from `OriginalTitle` and their other names from `Titles`, now that `Name`, `OriginalName` and `AlternativeNames` are gone
- Implement case-insensitive, whitespace-ignoring deduplication for studio tags via `DistinctBy` in `GetStudioTags`
- Bump Shoko.Abstractions to v6.0.0-alpha.108


**Contributions:**
* @revam in https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/pull/20

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.20.2...v0.21.0
